patterns.note: Full-bleed, immersive hero sections that dominate the initial viewport, transitioning to structured content blocks below with alternating background colors.
Prominent, clean sans-serif typography for headings, often in all caps or with strong weight, contrasted with a more neutral sans-serif for body text.
A high-contrast palette featuring a deep charcoal/black, a bright, almost neon yellow accent, and clean whites/off-whites for text and background variations.
The initial hero area features a scroll-triggered sequence of full-screen 3D rendered objects that replace each other as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic and artistic introduction.
Distinctive 'visual narrative' sections that use large-scale photography, illustrations, or 3D renders to tell a story or introduce a theme, often preceding detailed information.

technique_notes: The site employs a WebGL/Three.js powered full-screen canvas to present a series of high-fidelity 3D models that dynamically swap and animate as the user scrolls, creating an interactive and artistic hero experience.
Content sections are visually separated by alternating background colors (dark charcoal and off-white) and often feature large, full-bleed images or illustrations alongside text blocks.
Call-to-action buttons and key interactive elements are highlighted with a vibrant yellow fill, providing strong visual contrast and guiding user attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (2-3x body text) provide strong visual hierarchy, with smaller uppercase labels for navigation and secondary information.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout for all elements, including buttons, images, and section containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with very airy hero sections focusing on large visuals, and comfortable padding in content sections.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the use of a full-screen, scroll-triggered 3D environment in the hero section, which dynamically displays different rendered objects as the user scrolls down. This creates a highly immersive and artistic introduction, setting a unique tone that goes beyond typical video or static image heroes.
